sections.label: NEA borrowing sources widened
sections.summary: The NEA Act currently limits NEA's borrowing to the Government or, with the Minister for Finance's approval, banks or other financial institutions, so NEA cannot borrow directly from capital markets.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: The current provisions in the NEA Act limit NEA's borrowing sources to either the Government, or, with the approval of the Minister for Finance, banks or other financial institutions.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: Hence, NEA is currently not able to, for example, borrow directly from the capital markets.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: This amendment will provide NEA with greater flexibility in borrowing by widening the options of funding sources, thereby optimising financing costs.

sections.label: Clause 2 NEA borrowing powers
sections.summary: Clause 2 repeals and re-enacts section 23 of the NEA Act to let NEA raise loans from the Government or another source with the Minister for Finance's approval, and make credit facility agreements.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: Clause 2 of the Bill will repeal and re-enact section 23 of the NEA Act to allow NEA to (a)	raise loans from the Government; (b)	raise loans from another source within or outside Singapore, with the approval of the Minister for Finance; and (c)	make financial agreements under which credit facilities are granted to the agency for the purchase of goods, materials or things.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: To conclude, Sir, this Bill will align the borrowing powers of NEA with those of other Statutory Boards in Singapore, to widen the options of funding sources and provide greater flexibility in borrowing.
